visualComparison.matched: 232x32 compact capsule,r16,padx10,gap8,16x16 original battery icon,12/16 regular Geist label and12/16 medium Geist Mono percentage; existing split260+6+32 geometry. No original SVG root dimension/color/path is changed.
visualComparison.variants: Handoff behavior adds honest On battery/Plugged in/Battery low labels and an em dash with unavailable tooltip for unknown percentage. Read-only Peek uses the shared shell and actual pushed facts, not a permanent monitor or settings panel.
visualComparison.accessibility: All32 light/dark1x/1.5x final captures match repeated bytes; default axe has zero violations and incompletes, no exclusions. Bundled Geist is measured.

timingDecision: Four seconds of elapsed time from the change, including while hidden/queued/disabled. Repeated identical samples do not reset or revive the activity. Startup/recovery is a quiet baseline. Meaningful changes are known source change, charging transition and changed low percentage<=20 when AC is not known online; ordinary healthy and known-AC charging percentage drift stays quiet. No permanent low/charging activity.
apiBoundary: GetSystemPowerStatus values are decoded with unknown/no-battery sentinels; registered AC/DC and percentage GUIDs plus status/resume messages trigger one read. The existing native control HWND owns/revokes registrations. Registration failure is retained separately in the cached snapshot, with legacy broadcasts still usable. Real power/sleep/settings changes are not exercised.
nativeShadowNote: Body alpha>=128 separates the antialiased232x32 capsule from its original32%-opacity shadow. Full shadow bounds and all original pixels are retained.
